subject: Locked out of my account
body: I typed my password wrong a few times this morning and now it says my account is locked. I have a client call at 10.

subject: Password expired, can't log in
body: Got the password expired message on my laptop and cannot log in at all now. Working from the Philadelphia office today.

subject: Reset password please
body: Forgot my password after vacation. Can you reset it?

subject: New phone, MFA codes gone
body: I got a new iPhone yesterday and the Authenticator app is empty. Cannot get past the verification code screen.

subject: Authenticator keeps saying code invalid
body: Every code from the authenticator app says invalid. Time on the phone looks right.

subject: VPN will not connect from home
body: GlobalProtect spins and then says could not connect to gateway. Home Wi-Fi works fine for everything else.

subject: How do I set up VPN on the new laptop
body: Just got the new laptop from the office. Where do I get GlobalProtect and what portal address do I use?

subject: Printer on 4th floor NY not printing
body: The Canon on the 4th floor in New York shows my job as sent but nothing comes out. Other people can print.

subject: Scan to email not working
body: Scanning from the Philadelphia lobby printer, the email never arrives. Tried twice.

subject: Outlook stuck on updating inbox
body: Outlook has said updating inbox since yesterday. Webmail shows new mail. Restarted twice.

subject: Not receiving emails from a vendor
body: Emails from billing@acmecorp.com never arrive. They say they sent three. Nothing in junk.

subject: Shared mailbox missing in Outlook
body: I was told I have access to the sales shared mailbox but it does not show up in Outlook.

subject: How do I share my calendar with my manager
body: Is there a way to let my manager see my calendar details, not just free or busy?

subject: How to record a Teams meeting
body: Can you show me where the record button is in Teams, and where the recording ends up?

subject: Access to the finance shared drive
body: Please add me to the finance shared drive. My manager Dana approved it in our 1:1.

subject: New hire starts Monday
body: Jordan Lee starts Monday in marketing, New York office. Needs laptop, email, Teams, and access to the marketing drive.

subject: Need Visio installed
body: I need Visio for network diagrams for the audit. Can it be installed this week?

subject: Adobe Acrobat licence
body: Acrobat says my licence is not valid anymore. I sign contracts daily so this is blocking.

subject: Laptop will not turn on
body: My laptop will not turn on at all. No light, tried the charger from a colleague. Philadelphia office.

subject: Docking station only shows one monitor
body: Since the update my dock only drives one of my two monitors. Swapped cables, same thing.

subject: Reporting server disk is full
body: The reporting server (RPT-01) says disk full and the nightly job failed. Finance needs the report by noon.

subject: Backup job failed last night
body: The backup job for the file server shows failed with error 0x8007 in the console. Second night in a row.

subject: Suspicious email asking for gift cards
body: I got an email that looks like it is from our CEO asking me to buy gift cards. I did not click anything. Is this phishing?

subject: I clicked a link in a strange email
body: I clicked a link in an email about a shared document and it asked me to log in. I typed my password before I realised. What do I do?

subject: Firewall rule for ping and traceroute
body: We need to allow ping and traceroute from the New York office to the monitoring server in Philadelphia for the new NOC tool.

subject: Open port 8443 for vendor appliance
body: Vendor needs inbound 8443 to the new appliance in the PA data closet from their support range.

subject: Wi-Fi down on the whole 3rd floor
body: Nobody on the 3rd floor in New York can get on Wi-Fi since about 9am. Wired desks work.

subject: Philadelphia office cannot reach the file server
body: Everyone in Philadelphia gets a timeout opening the file server. New York is fine. Started 20 minutes ago.

subject: Email is down for everyone
body: Nobody can send or receive email, the whole office is affected. Outlook and webmail both fail.

subject: Freshservice portal down for all users
body: The support portal returns a 503 for all users in both offices. We cannot log tickets.
